name: ValueScope
description: A standardized DCF valuation engine for A-share, HK, US and Japan stocks. The AI reasons about each assumption, the engine owns the data and the math — the same inputs always produce the same valuation.
description_zh: 标准化 DCF 估值引擎，覆盖 A股、港股、美股、日股。AI 负责前瞻判断，引擎负责数据与计算，同样的输入永远得到同样的估值结果。A股与港股无需任何密钥。
description_en: A standardized DCF valuation engine for A-share, HK, US and Japan stocks. The AI reasons about each assumption, the engine owns the data and the math — the same inputs always produce the same valuation.
examples_zh: 给贵州茅台（600519.SS）做一份 DCF 估值
腾讯控股 0700.HK 现在的股价隐含了什么增长假设？
用乐观/中性/悲观三种情景估一下美的集团 000333.SZ
宁德时代的内在价值是多少？关键假设是哪一个
招商银行现在贵不贵，安全边际有多少
examples_en: Run a DCF valuation on Kweichow Moutai (600519.SS)
What growth assumptions does Tencent's (0700.HK) price imply?
Value Midea (000333.SZ) under bull, base and bear cases
What is CATL's intrinsic value, and which assumption drives it?
How much margin of safety is there in China Merchants Bank today?
